name: Object-level weed species benchmark
description: An object-level benchmark measuring deep learning models' ability to detect and classify multiple weed species in agricultural images.
reputation: Published in a peer-reviewed agricultural journal and referenced in applied agricultural computer-vision work, but not a large-scale community benchmark.
notes: Non-LLM object-detection benchmark; possible class imbalance, environmental variability (lighting/occlusion), and limited dataset scale compared to large generic detection datasets.
